articles.summary: You don't need source code access or reverse engineering to create APIs from legacy software. Workflow observation captures the real request behavior and produces stable endpoints your systems can call.
articles.title: How to Turn Legacy Software Into an API Without Reverse Engineering

articles.summary: Modern anti-bot systems use TLS fingerprinting, behavioral analysis, and device attestation to block scrapers. Understanding these techniques explains why browser automation fails and what alternatives exist.
articles.title: How Anti-Bot Detection Works and Why It Breaks Web Scrapers

articles.summary: AI agents need APIs to take actions, but many critical business systems have no API. Workflow APIs bridge this gap by turning human-operated software into callable endpoints for autonomous agents.
articles.title: How AI Agents Can Execute Tasks in Legacy Systems That Have No API
